_note: hard_constraints are enforced by validate.py and are NOT learnable by the weekly retro. facts are the Researcher's dated, sourced algorithm notes; DESIGNED TO BE DELETED once live model knowledge + search is reliable. Researcher may append facts; only Manik edits hard_constraints.

facts.fact: Dwell time, saves and private sends outweigh reactions; comment quality is read semantically; generic AI-written posts are suppressed.
One external link in the post body cuts median reach about 19% (van der Blom, 1.3M posts); other 2026 analyses say up to ~60%. Link-in-first-comment is reportedly detected too.
facts.source: van der Blom Algorithm Insights; Dataslayer 2026

facts.fact: LinkedIn is actively detecting and removing engagement pods.
facts.source: Forbes (Jodie Cook) 2026-03-18; LinkedIn VP Product Gyanda Sachdeva

facts.fact: Member post analytics API exposes IMPRESSION, MEMBERS_REACHED, POST_SAVE, POST_SEND, COMMENT, FOLLOWER_GAINED_FROM_CONTENT, PROFILE_VIEW_FROM_CONTENT (POST_SAVE/POST_SEND added in 202604).
Indian audience peak around 8 AM IST on weekdays (MagicPost, 220,220 Indian posts measured in IST); others say 9-11 AM Tue-Thu.
facts.source: magicpost.in best time to post India

facts.fact: Max 5 hashtags per post since 2025-12-18; hashtags help categorisation/search, not reach.
Top signals: watch time, likes, sends; sends matter most for non-follower reach. Skip rate (first 3s) replaced view rate in Aug 2025.
facts.source: Mosseri statements Jan 2025; creator analytics guides

facts.fact: Originality enforcement extended to photos and carousels on 2026-04-30; accounts reposting 10+ others' pieces in 30 days lose recommendations.
facts.source: exemplary.ai; creatorflow.so summaries of Meta updates

facts.fact: AI-generated profile/content labels shipped 2026-08-31: label AI media openly.
Graph API: Professional account required; 'views' replaced impressions (impressions removed 2025-04-21); ~25 API publishes per 24h.
Original Reels prioritised; lightly edited re-uploads (borders, captions, speed changes, logo overlays) deprioritised.
facts.source: Meta Newsroom: Rewarding Original Creators on Facebook (2026-03-13)

facts.fact: 36.6% of US Feed content views in Q2 2026 came from unconnected recommended posts (39.0% in Q1).
facts.source: Meta Widely Viewed Content Report Q2 2026

facts.fact: No API can publish to or read insights from a personal profile; Professional Mode dashboard shows 90 days of reach/engagement/3-second views.

Open-sourced Grok-based ranker (2026-01-20) default weights: like 0.5, repost 1.0, reply 5.0, quote 5.0, share-by-copied-link 20.0, link open 0.2; mutual-follow reply boosts to 20.0. Weights scale predicted probabilities, not raw counts (README note 2026-08-14).
API is pay-per-use since free tier ended 2026-02-06: about $0.015 per post created ($0.20 with URL), $0.005 per post read, $0.010 per user read.
